reviews.title: Gamer husband loves it
reviews.comment:
Bought this for my husband as a surprise the same night he bought his new microphone, it fits perfectly easy to set up and secure to the desk
From what I have felt it feels high quality and there is no wobbliness so it’s very sturdy
I would say get this one it’s worth the money and you’re not having to pay massive amounts of money for a quality product
reviews.author: Cheyenne

reviews.title: Decent product
reviews.comment: Pretty good for the price honestly couldn’t find something any better for as little as I spent on it
reviews.author: dakotah Wilson

reviews.title: Decent Arm!
reviews.comment: I received the Boom arm and clamp, but not the cover for the actual microphone itself? Other than that, I mean, it does what it says it does. It's a little cheaply made but decent enough for anyone not wanting to spend 50+ dollars on a arm. Light-weight, extends pretty far, and is SUPER easy to setup.
reviews.author: Anna
